ui.herr_lema: Free things you can take. Nothing installs itself: each one gives its real path.

ui.herr_cerrada: Closed, and this is the reason
ui.herr_audio_causa: in preparation on the rack: two projects, ecosystem music (yue2-solarpunk) and lore voices (auk-flash-preceptor), with their pipelines written. They stop with NO_DATA because their models are not installed yet: several GB and a missing signature.
ui.herr_agora: The state of the Agora: downloads, signatures and what is missing
ui.herr_modelos: The models that speak on the web
ui.herr_modelos_nota: The same ones that answer in the Tower. Base models install with one command on your machine; house models are built on top of them and are not distributed that way yet.
ui.herr_modelo_casa: House model: it does not install with “ollama pull” yet. It is built on its base model; its published adapters are above, in “The state of the Agora”.
ui.herr_desc_nix: Downloads install.sh from GitHub Releases. Run it with: bash install.sh — it asks for no password and installs nothing behind your back.
ui.herr_desc_win: Downloads install.ps1 from GitHub Releases. Right-click → “Run with PowerShell” — it asks for no password and installs nothing behind your back.
ui.herr_desc_apk: The APK does not exist yet: on Android it installs through Termux, with the guide below.
ui.herr_desc_ios: There is no app for iPhone: install this site from Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
